API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPrivateUpdate Public Account Details
Update Public Account Details
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudAccountDetails/:id

Updates public cloud account information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

Internal ID of public cloud account/subscription.

accountId
string

Account or subscription ID of public cloud account.

platformId
string

Public cloud platform (AWS or Azure).

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE]

Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Internal ID of public cloud account/subscription.

accountId

Account or subscription ID of public cloud account.

platformId
string

Public cloud platform (AWS or Azure).

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE]
